sentences.en: The soft warm beige had a yellow highlight that reflected the evening sun.

sentences.en: As I unscrew the top, I marvel at the pink color because it's a glorious combination of pink, brown, and just a hint of apricot; I'm very hopeful that the color will be flattering on my honey beige skin.

sentences.en: The Estate line offers a wide variety of styles including modern transitional to traditional, while Modern Age offers versatile patterns in colors such as beige, deep brown, rust and light blue accents.
sentences.vi: Dòng Estate cung cấp nhiều phong cách khác nhau bao gồm chuyển tiếp từ hiện đại sang truyền thống, trong khi Modern Age cung cấp các mẫu linh hoạt với các màu sắc như màu be, nâu trầm, gỉ sét và các điểm nhấn màu xanh lam nhạt.

sentences.en: Please note that the marketing picture is in error and the white pieces are white, not beige.
sentences.vi: Xin lưu ý rằng hình ảnh tiếp thị bị lỗi và các mảnh màu trắng có màu trắng, không phải màu be.

sentences.en: The carapace is usually beige with a distinctive black triangle with the apex pointing toward the abdomen and the base toward the pedipalps.

sentences.en: Some might look OK in the ex-service club; others are excellent pinks, purples, reds and any color that is n't beige.

sentences.en: It needn't be a time for self neglect or to become ' the invisible woman ' doomed to wear beige for ever more.
